_howto: Copy one of the point features below, paste it into the 'features' list,
and change the fields. Keep the commas between features.
geometry.coordinates : [longitude, latitude]  (note: LONG first, then LAT)
properties.id        : short url-safe slug, e.g. 'lake-atitlan' (used in the link)
properties.place     : the place name shown on the page
properties.date      : any text, e.g. 'on the Skeena, late summer'
properties.coords    : the pretty coordinate string shown on the page
properties.color     : a word (emerald, marigold, clay, coral, sage, water) OR a hex like '#3a7ca5'
properties.order     : a number; entries are threaded together in this order (lowest first)
properties.stanzas   : the poem. A list of {t, r} pairs: t = the lines, r = the refrain.
For line breaks inside t, write \n .
For a prose entry instead of a poem, use 'body' (a paragraph of text) and omit 'stanzas'.
To override the auto-drawn thread with a real path, add a feature with
geometry.type 'LineString' and properties.role 'route'. Its coordinates are
[[lng,lat],[lng,lat],...]. If no such feature exists, the thread auto-draws

properties.title: Pale Remembrances
properties.teaser: A poem from the Skeena — catching, holding a life dangling between us, and letting it go.

stanzas.t:
turquoise rushing,
within millenia of connected disorder.

This morning holds ambivalence,
a subtle smallness,
constructed by,
cool, damp divine.

The fish are here,
the trees, the brush, the roses,
a single collective force.

From your world to mine,
your power pours into my desire
for entitled freedom

im obligated to let you go,
gasping,
life dangling between us.

on the sheen of river stones
you disappear into the malaise,
leaving my soul alone,
guilty and yearning.

properties.title: The town with no addresses
properties.teaser: On navigating by memory instead of street number, where an address is a story you tell.
